|date=Between [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]<ref name="Date 1 BBY">According to {{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/unfinished1|text=Unfinished Business, Part 1: Gunrunner|int=Unfinished Business (scenario)}}, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] utilized [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] the attack on [[Praaelon Di]] took place. ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' establishes that the Alliance acquired the resources necessary to start the production of [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighters]] a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which translates to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, the attack on Praaelon Di must have occurred no earlier than 1 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|BBY]].</ref> and [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]<ref name="Date 3.5 ABY">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/unfinished2|text=Unfinished Business, Part 2: Well-Armed and Dangerous|int=Unfinished Business (scenario)}} features [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] as a participant in the attack on [[Praaelon Di]]. {{WEGCite|story=Bounty's Due|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}} depicts [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] being [[Death/Legends|killed]], while ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of the ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' multimedia project, which includes the ''Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook'', to [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. Therefore, the attack on Praaelon Di must have occurred no later than 3.5 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref>

An '''attack''' on the [[Arms dealer/Legends|gunrunner]] [[Praaelon Di]] was carried out by a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]<ref name="UB1" /> at some point between [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]<ref name="Date 1 BBY" /> and [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].<ref name="Date 3.5 ABY" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on Praaelon Di first appeared in "Gunrunner,"<ref name="UB1" /> the opening installment in "[[Unfinished Business (scenario)|Unfinished Business]]," a series of three scenarios for use with the [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Star Wars Miniatures|''Star Wars'' Miniatures]] game. The series was written by [[Sterling Hershey]],<ref name="UB1" /><ref name="UB3" /><ref name="UB2" /> and the first scenario was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[February 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="UB1" />
